summary: Correct, minimal fix replacing `^...$` with `\A...\Z` in both username validators, which properly rejects trailing-newline usernames — this matches Django's actual upstream resolution. Only trivial diff noise (a stray leading blank line and a no-op `flags = 0` re-write) detracts.

issues.description: Adds a stray blank line at the top of the file before `import re`, unrelated to the fix. Should be dropped to keep the diff clean.
`flags = 0` is shown as removed and re-added with no semantic change (whitespace/newline noise), adding pointless churn to the diff.
